title: The Estoc Primer
summary: A plain primer teaching stance, grip and the straight thrust of the estoc to an untrained student with no qi.

title: A Beginner's Book of the Stiff Point
summary: A short beginner's book on holding the stiff blade upright and driving its point along one straight line.

title: Point-First Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of repeated target exercises that train the thrust, the recovery and the close pommel knock.

title: Workbook of the Square Blade
summary: A workbook on the four faces of the square-sectioned blade, with thrust drills for students whose tendons are already hardened.

title: Handbook of the Long Thrusting Blade
summary: A handbook on measuring reach and shortening the grip for close work, taught to students of hardened bone.

title: The Estoc Footwork Reader
summary: A reader on the stepping and recovery that carry the estoc's thrust, with a first thread of qi along the blade.

title: Treatise on the Armor Gap Thrust
summary: A short treatise on finding the gaps of armor and placing the narrow point into them.

title: A Primer of the Two-Hand Estoc
summary: A primer for the long two-handed estoc, covering the settled guard, the hip-driven lunge and the pommel smash.

title: The Ring and Seam Workbook
summary: A workbook of drills for parting mail rings and probing the seams of leather and plate with the point.

title: Short Course in the Bound Point
summary: A short course on crossing blades, reading the pressure of a bind and thrusting from it.

title: The Plain Canon of the Stiff Blade
summary: A plain canon gathering the six everyday strokes of the estoc for students ready to move toward the Intermediate texts.
